india.one_line: India leads global AI maturity and policy discussions while domestic enterprises scale local coding, voice, and workforce agents.

themes.title: AI agents gain traction across India
themes.text: Entire partnered with Sarvam AI to offer locally hosted coding agents with data residency in India, while Anthropic expanded its Claude Duet AI agent research preview to the country. Meanwhile, IBM Research built an Indic voice agent using the CUGA harness for agricultural queries, and a KPMG-CII report noted that 93 percent of Indian business leaders plan to deploy AI agents.

stories.headline: Entire partners with Sarvam to bring AI coding agents to India
93% of Indian business leaders plan to adopt AI agents, report says
IBM Research builds Indic voice agent using CUGA harness
Anthropic expands Claude Duet AI agent research preview to India

themes.title: Infrastructure and enterprise tech milestones
themes.text: Infosys reached CMMI AI Maturity Level 5 as the first organization globally, and Wipro secured a deal to manage BP's finance operations using AI and automation. Additionally, Nexent Capital launched a $1 billion fund to invest in AI data center and energy infrastructure in India and North America.

stories.headline: BP to transfer 3,000 finance staff to Wipro in AI transformation deal
Infosys reaches CMMI AI Maturity Level 5, first organization worldwide
Nexent Capital launches $1 billion fund for AI data‑center and energy infrastructure

themes.title: India stresses AI oversight at UN
themes.text: At a UN Security Council debate, India called for human oversight in the application of artificial intelligence during conflicts.

stories.headline: India stresses human oversight in AI use during conflicts at UN
